questions.original: Cheiser me ronea cuando va drogado
questions.issue: 'Cheiser' = 'chaser' (cis man who fetishizes trans women), kept as 'Chaser'; 'ronear' = to flirt/hit on.

questions.original: Ke me esconda pa besarte en el baño
questions.issue: Unclear who speaks and whether 'ke me esconda' is 'let me hide' or 'make me hide' (the chaser demanding secrecy). Lines 0-1 may be the chaser's demands; rendered neutrally.

questions.original: doy lache engancha a este pinpin
questions.issue: 'lache' (caló, shame/disgust/'dar lache') and 'pinpin' are unclear; I kept both words and guessed 'pinpin' is a slang term for the guy (a sucker/fool).

questions.original: Miradas ajenas me pongo una vela
questions.issue: 'me pongo una vela' unclear: light a candle (fits the 'shining' image), or 'put on a sail'. Rendered as light a candle.

questions.original: bihotzak bum bum eta harma tiro pum
questions.issue: Basque, with 'harma' (dialectal 'arma') and Spanish 'tiro'. 'bihotzak' could be singular ergative or plural 'hearts'; I chose singular 'the heart'.
